evidence: With XLA forced to 4 CPU devices, the reproduced run matched the report's pattern: NUTS lag-1 autocorrelation was 0.449453, AIES was 0.940259, and ESS was 0.022275. ESS is the clear outlier and has much lower autocorrelation than both comparison samplers.
steps: Create a 4-device CPU JAX runtime so the reported parallel/vectorized chain methods can execute.
Run the local NumPyro 0.18.0 checkout on the Poisson-with-Uniform-prior model from the bug report.
Compare lag-1 autocorrelation of flattened posterior draws for NUTS, AIES, and ESS.
